name: web-thanks-slide-with-serif-line-hand-card-and-follow-pills
title: Thanks slide with roman and italic serif, a hand holding a bank card, a walker with phone and glass contact pills
whatItIs: A white-to-pale-blue slide with 'Thanks For Being Here Today' in navy serif and italic, a cut-out hand holding a gradient Visa card at left, a woman in a hoodie with headphones checking her phone at right, a cursor, and two glass pills with an email and a Follow button.
whatItMeans: Warm and professional; cutouts framing the text give a human sign-off.
techniques: Frame a centred serif message with two cutouts.
Set the second line in italic.
Use glass pills for contact and follow.
Fade the background to pale blue.

vocabulary.definition: Cutout images on both sides of a message.
Regular and italic of one serif in two lines.
A closing slide with thanks and contact.
